learning_curve.sampling: Nested company permutations within each outer train; ceil(fraction*companies), whole companies, no label stratification. Model seed fixed.
learning_curve.std: Sample standard deviation across5 sampling seeds, not a confidence interval;100% is the same deterministic fit.

confidence.protocol: Common R3 trained on60% of outer-training companies;20% disjoint isotonic,20% disjoint threshold/conformal. Scene model fits3-fold company-OOF in proper60%. No calibration or test company in any ranking fit used on that role.
confidence.conformal_definition: 101 labels (100 candidates+OUTSIDE), nonconformity1-softmax(candidate), OUTSIDE=1; group-max split quantile ceil((m+1)*(1-alpha)); singleton candidate only SUR.
confidence.conformal_warning: 98% marginal/group set coverage is NOT98% selective precision. Exchangeability is not certified on this consumed pilot and supervised frozen upstream.
